legend.0: Small value: the change only tidies wording, comments, documents, names or code structure, or adds an optional extra. Nobody is blocked or misled without it, and nothing anyone does changes.
legend.1: The default: a wanted addition or change with a clear gain for users or maintainers, who can work without it today.
legend.2: Harm to users or maintainers now: without the change they are blocked, misled, lose data or work, or must redo work today.
